jobs.title: Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation
jobs.location: United States, United Kingdom, Nigeria, Rwanda, Ethiopia, DRC, India
jobs.description: Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) is a global health organization that partners locally and globally to create and scale solutions to the world’s deadliest health threats. Millions of people die from preventable health threats. We collaborate to close the gap between proven, life-saving solutions and the people who need them. Since 2017, we’ve worked with governments and other partners in more than 60 countries to save millions of lives. We work toward a future where people live longer, healthier lives, communities flourish, and economies thrive. This is an ambitious vision, and it inspires us and our partners to make progress every day.   Resolve to Save Lives (RTSL) works with governments and partners to strengthen and transform primary health care (PHC) to improve health and save lives. Our approach focuses on making PHC more prioritised, proactive and accountable for outcomes, and strengthening how care is organised, delivered, financed and measured. Drawing on expertise across RTSL s portfolio, we bring together solutions in health system resilience and epidemic readiness, digital health and data-driven decision-making, performance measurement and improvement, and sustainable health financing. We apply these capabilities to address priority health challenges, including cardiovascular health, maternal survival and sexual and reproductive health, while strengthening health systems to deliver more equitable, effective and resilient care.   Position Purpose The Senior Technical Advisor, Clinical Services & Health Systems Transformation will provide senior-level technical expertise to strengthen how health services are organised, managed and delivered, with an initial focus on improving maternal survival and reproductive health outcomes. Drawing on deep clinical experience and specialized expertise in health systems strengthening, systems thinking, and change management, the role leads complex technical initiatives and supports governments and country teams

jobs.description: Deskripsi Pekerjaan: Memberikan pelayanan massage dan reflexology kepada customer sesuai SOP perusahaan. Melakukan treatment dengan teknik yang telah ditentukan dan memperhatikan kenyamanan serta kebutuhan customer. Menjaga kebersihan, kerapihan, dan kesiapan area treatment sebelum dan sesudah digunakan. Memberikan pelayanan yang ramah, sopan, dan profesional kepada setiap customer. Mengikuti training, evaluasi, dan pengembangan skill yang diberikan perusahaan. Mematuhi SOP, standar grooming, kedisiplinan, serta peraturan perusahaan. Kualifikasi: Wanita dan pria sehat jasmani dan rohani. Memiliki minat bekerja di bidang massage, reflexology, wellness, dan pelayanan. Pengalaman sebagai therapist menjadi nilai tambah. Fresh graduate/non-pengalaman dipersilakan melamar karena akan diberikan training. Bersedia mengikuti masa training dan probation. Jujur, disiplin, bertanggung jawab, dan memiliki attitude yang baik. Ramah dan mampu berkomunikasi dengan baik. Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift. Bersedia bekerja pada weekend dan hari libur sesuai jadwal. Berpenampilan bersih dan rapi. Mampu bekerja secara individu maupun dalam tim. Benefit: Gaji pokok. Uang transport. Bonus/insentif. Training dan pengembangan skill. Kesempatan pengembangan karier. Lingkungan kerja profesional di bidang wellness.

jobs.title: Phlebotomist Team Lead
jobs.description: Getlabs is the leading platform for at-home diagnostics. Healthcare organizations use Getlabs to send mobile phlebotomists to patients’ homes and collect labs, vitals, and advanced diagnostics. By leveraging Getlabs, partners can improve patient adherence and close gaps in care with same-day, nationwide availability. Our team has raised $50M from strategic investors including the two largest diagnostic laboratories in the United States, Labcorp and Quest. Getlabs’ mission is to save lives by expanding access to diagnostics for everyone. About the Role We are seeking a full-time Team Leader to join our fast-growing team. In this hands-on role, lead a team of phlebotomists across different regions day to day, supporting the Field Supervisor and Operations Manager in your market. You will use Leader Standard Work (LSW) a simple, repeatable routine of daily check-ins, quick huddles, and follow-ups to keep the team on track, catch problems early, and make sure every patient has a great experience. This is a great fit for an experienced front-line healthcare worker, who is ready to grow into leadership. We are looking for someone who is organized, dependable, coachable, and eager to help others succeed. At Getlabs, you will: Lead, coach, and support a team of mobile phlebotomists, serving as their first point of contact for questions and support. Follow a daily Leader Standard Work routine: start-of-day check-ins, review of the day's schedule and routes, and end-of-day follow-ups. Run short team meetings to share priorities, updates, wins, and safety or quality reminders. Track key daily metrics (e.g., on-time arrivals, completed visits, specimen quality) on visual boards or dashboards, and flag issues to the Field Supervisor. Use simple problem-solving tools (e.g., 5 Whys) to find root causes and follow through on action items. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Global Access
jobs.description: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. Key Responsibilities Vendor Management Serve as the primary point of contact for all external vendors collaborating with myTomorrows within the Global Access function. Support procurement efforts during vendor RFP processes, including requirements scoping, proposal evaluation, selection, and contracting. Collaborate with the quality and legal team during vendor onboarding and ongoing maintenance, ensuring all documentation, SOPs, and compliance records are accurate and up to date. Conduct structured regular check-ins with vendors to monitor performance, track program milestones, and resolve operational issues in a timely manner. The CDM works on multi-functional teams and supports clinical trial projects as a departmental subject matter expert (SME). We are seeking a temporary clinical data manager who can dedicate 20 hours a week to support ongoing study activities.
